regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, DOI, ESI/CCDC sentence
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate Au-catalyzed cycloisomerization claim. The paper mentions ESI and CCDC 1956055/1956072, but workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
The generic 2-allenylindole 6-/7-exo cycloisomerization is explicitly cited previous work (ref. 4), retained as a literature example rather than a current experiment.
Four separate cited arrows—6-endo, 6-exo, 5-endo, and [2+2] reactions of 3-allenylindoles—were classified as literature examples with displayed ee ranges where present.
Four cited N-allenyl/N-butadienyl-indole arrows (5-exo, [3+2]/[2+2], Au cycloisomerization, and Pt/Au arene addition) were classified as prior work; no current-paper yields were assigned.
The lower c3 arrow is the generic current reaction class and has no row-specific yield. The natural-product drawings are contextual structures, not reactions.

unresolved: Generic R groups and compact structures do not define unique machine structures.
ESI association is unestablished; CCDC identifiers are crystallographic depositions, not imported SI.
